expectations.text: Output includes an analysis of existing notification infrastructure before proposing new work
expectations.evidence: Section 2 'Current State Analysis' covers the existing notifications table, DB triggers, RLS, service layer, hooks, UI pages, and identifies specific gaps.

expectations.text: Output proposes a notification_preferences table design with proper foreign keys
expectations.evidence: Section 3.1 defines notification_preferences with employee_id FK to employees, unique constraint on (employee_id, event_type), and indexes.

expectations.text: Output includes a database schema design with SQL or schema notation
expectations.evidence: Section 3 provides full SQL CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, CREATE INDEX, and RLS policy statements.

expectations.text: Output includes an implementation plan with sequenced steps (what to build first, second, third)
expectations.evidence: Section 9 'Implementation Sequence' has 6 phases with specific steps, files, and estimated hours per step.

expectations.text: Output covers security considerations including RLS policies
expectations.evidence: Section 7 'Security Considerations' covers 8 concerns with mitigations including RLS policies, channel leakage prevention, trigger safety, and rate limiting.

expectations.text: Output identifies at least 5 edge cases or potential failure modes
expectations.evidence: Section 8 'Edge Cases' identifies 11 edge cases covering offline, multi-tab, deleted user, bulk notifications, race conditions, and more.

expectations.text: Output addresses integration with existing auth system (employee_id, user_id)
expectations.evidence: Section 6 'Integration with Existing System' covers auth integration through employee_id scoping, RLS enforcement, and unauthenticated user handling.

expectations.text: Output proposes real-time subscription architecture using Supabase Realtime
expectations.evidence: Section 4.3 defines real-time channels filtered by employee_id. Section 5.1 describes NotificationProvider subscribing to Supabase Realtime.

claims.claim: Identified existing notification infrastructure (table, triggers, service, UI)
claims.evidence: Section 2 provides an 11-row status table of existing infrastructure

claims.claim: Proposed 6 implementation phases with time estimates
claims.evidence: Section 9 has 6 phases totaling ~34 hours with per-step estimates

eval_feedback.overall: All assertions passed. The with-skill output follows the skill's workflow (current state analysis first, then database, API, UI, integration, security, edge cases, sequenced plan).
